title: tpu-roofline Request
description: Input payload for the tpu-roofline agent. The caller states in `prompt` what it needs a hardware floor for: one op, a block of code, a whole model on a slice, or only the rows a gap affects at given cells. Everything else is optional context. `tpu` is required: the agent reads that TPU's specs from tpu-knowledge-base. The agent decides the path and returns `invalid_input` listing every required choice (sharding, workload) the request leaves out.

prompt.description: What to model, in the caller's own words: the op, code block or model, and any shapes, dtypes, hardware, sharding or workload the caller already knows.

run_id.description: Identifier of the active TPU agent suite run namespace.

tpu.description: The TPU to model. Its specs are looked up from accelerator_type, never assumed.

accelerator_type.description: The TPU_ACCELERATOR_TYPE string, generation and chip count, e.g. tpu7x-8 or v6e-8. The generation (tpu7x, v6e) is the knowledge-base key for its specs.

topology.description: Slice topology, e.g. 2x2x2; sets the config's slice_dims.

context.description: Optional free-form inputs the caller already holds, for example a config path, a source file, a model id, the slice, the sharding or the workload. Keys are not fixed.

rows.description: Optional operator rows to price, named as roofline.py prints them (e.g. 'MLA: QK Rope'). When given, the result carries a floor per row and cell in `rows`, not a full report.

cells.description: Optional operating points to price, one per microbenchmark cell, in the shape of a roofline config's `phases` entry. Each becomes one phase; they replace the workload for Path B.

name.description: The cell's name in the caller's plan; results are keyed by it.

kv_len.description: Context length each request attends over.

mnbt.description: max-num-batched-tokens, which sets the prefill chunking.

output_dir.description: Optional directory for the outputs. Defaults to the run's artifacts/roofline/ directory.

examples.prompt: Roofline of the MoE down-projection of GLM-5.2 at 8K prefill tokens on one v7x chip, fp8 weights.
Model the GLM-5.2-FP8 serving roofline on v7x 2x2x2.
Floors for the rows around the MLA QK Rope gap, GLM-5.2-FP8 on v7x 2x2x2.
